name: web-js-stack-lsp
description: Web JavaScript stack language server for Claude Code. A Svelte language server for .svelte files, and a PostToolUse hook that runs the project's own ESLint on each JS, TS or Svelte file Claude edits, so React (react-hooks), Vite (react-refresh) and Svelte (eslint-plugin-svelte) rules reach Claude right after the edit. TypeScript, JavaScript, JSX and TSX stay with the official typescript-lsp plugin.
